title: Aegis-VLA: Reliability-Gated Action Refinement via a Trajectory World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33993v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic object manipulation requires maintaining spatial and temporal alignment with targets that continue to move during inference and execution. Although future prediction can inform action correction, an accurate forecast does not establish whether modifying an existing action would be beneficial. We present Aegis-VLA, a world-model-guided vision-language-action (VLA) framework that generates predictive action corrections and separately determines whether and how strongly to apply them. A Trajectory World Model combines kinematic extrapolation with learned residual dynamics to predict object motion and estimate positional uncertainty. Discrepancy-Guided Action Refinement uses differences between history-only and base-action-conditioned end-effector forecasts to propose bounded arm corrections. translated_title: Aegis-VLA：面向动态物体操纵的基于轨迹世界模型的可靠性门控动作修正
translated_abstract: 动态物体操纵需要在推理和执行过程中与持续移动的目标保持空间和时间上的对齐。尽管未来预测可以为动作修正提供信息，但准确的预测并不能确定修改现有动作是否真的有益。我们提出Aegis-VLA，这是一个由世界模型引导的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，能够生成预测性动作修正，并独立判断是否应用以及以多大强度应用这些修正。轨迹世界模型将运动学外推与学习到的残差动力学相结合，以预测物体运动并估计位置不确定性。差异引导动作细化利用仅基于历史的预测与以基础动作为条件的末端执行器预测之间的差异，提出有界的手臂修正。可靠性门控则依据相对于基础动作在演示中的改进程度，学习何时采纳修正，并调节其应用。
tldr: 提出Aegis-VLA框架，利用轨迹世界模型预测移动目标的运动，并通过可靠性门控决定是否以及以多大强度采纳预测性动作修正，从而实现动态物体操纵的可靠执行。
en_tdlr: Aegis-VLA presents a world-model-guided VLA framework in which a Trajectory World Model predicts the motion of moving objects and a Reliability Gate determines whether and how strongly to apply predictive action corrections for reliable dynamic object manipulation.
